create_padding_from_padfn: create padding for a convolution using create_from_padfn with a PadFn, kernel size, rate, and spatial dimensions
create_padding_from_tuple: create padding for a convolution using create_from_tuple with explicit pad_before and pad_after tuples
use_same_padding: use the same padding function to pad a convolution so output size matches input size at stride 1
use_causal_padding: use the causal padding function to pre-pad a convolution so output has no dependence on future inputs
check_is_padfn: check whether a given padding argument is a PadFn or sequence of PadFns using is_padfn
